comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Item 0 asks whether a comment gives a concrete real-world example (case, event, person, statistic-bearing situation, or personal experience) as support. Item 1 asks only whether a comment names a specific program or location. A named location or program can appear without being an example, for example a passing mention. A personal experience or unnamed real event counts for 0 but not for 1. Item 1 also has its own quotation and moderator-notice rules, which item 0 does not state. The two features overlap but are not the same extraction function.
